quests.title: Board Order: Night Lantern Stock
quests.description: Supply 1 Glow Potion so the night watch can keep the reopened greenhouse and footpaths safely lit.

quests.title: Board Order: Restorative Shelves
quests.description: Supply 1 Healing Draught for the infirmary shelves while the town copes with fatigue and strain.

quests.title: Board Order: Roadside Lanterns
quests.description: Keep 1 Lantern Draught on the board so the lamplighters can top up the footpath lights each night.

quests.title: Board Order: Field Poultices
quests.description: Supply 1 Field Poultice for the repair crews patching the roads before the season turns.

quests.title: Board Order: Light For The Desert Road
quests.description: Leave 1 Fine-or-better Sunscar Glass Elixir on the board. The carters want a lamp that survives the run to the dunes and back.

quests.title: Board Order: A Light That Does Not Flicker
quests.description: Leave 1 Excellent-or-better Resonance Draught on the board. The well crew works below the water table and will not go down behind a lamp that gutters.

quests.title: Standing Order: Outer Road Lanterns
quests.description: The watch's monthly draw. Leave 2 Excellent Nightwatch Lanterns on the board and the town pays the contracted rate without anyone having to ask.

quests.title: Standing Order: Infirmary Draw
quests.description: Mira's contracted resupply. Leave 2 Excellent Purified Draughts on the board and the counter stays stocked for a month without her chasing anybody.

quests.title: Seasonal Order: Laying In
quests.description: The square's winter stock. Leave 2 Fine-or-better Hollow Hearth Tonics on the board and the town has something to hand the crews who are out before light.

quests.title: Commission: One Flawless Pour
quests.description: A single Purified Draught, Excellent, carrying both pure and calm. The buyer has been specific to the point of rudeness and is paying accordingly.

quests.title: Standing Order: Something Settled
quests.description: One Stillkeeper Tonic carrying at least two of calm, cold and pure. Which two is the keeper's business, not the board's.

quests.title: Standing Order: A Lamp That Also Carries
quests.description: One Resonance Draught that both lights and steadies. The survey crew will not carry two bottles up a ladder.

quests.title: Bulk Order: Field Poultices, Three
quests.description: Three poultices, any workable grade. The road crews go through them faster than anyone can make them well.

quests.title: Rush Order: Nothing Fancy, Very Good
quests.description: One Healing Draught at Excellent, carrying restorative and healing both. It is the plainest recipe in the book and the board is paying four times its worth for a perfect one.

quests.title: Unsigned: A Purified Draught, Excellent
quests.description: No name on it. One Excellent Purified Draught, and the note specifies the pour must be clean rather than strong — which is an odd thing for a customer to know to ask for.

completion_milestones.title: No Name On It
completion_milestones.text: Somebody left an unsigned order on the board and paid four times the going rate for a clean pour. Elric checked: nobody in the valley posted it, and it was there before the board was unlocked for the morning.

quests.title: Unsigned: Something Luminous, Held Steady
quests.description: The same hand. A Wardlight Solution, Excellent. The note adds one line: hold it at the bench that favours the work, not the one that is nearest.

completion_milestones.title: That Is Not A Customer's Sentence
completion_milestones.text: The second unsigned note tells the brewer which bench to use. Ione's reading is that customers ask for outcomes and only practitioners ask for method — and that whoever is writing these already knows how this tower works.

quests.title: Unsigned: The Cordial, And Do Not Substitute
quests.description: Third and last. One Excellent Hollowroot Cordial, with the note that no substitution will be accepted — for a plant that stopped existing in this valley before anybody outside it could have known it was back.

completion_milestones.title: Read In Order
completion_milestones.text: Three unsigned orders, read in the order they were posted: a clean pour, the right bench, and a plant that had been extinct for twenty years. It is not a shopping list. It is somebody checking, one item at a time, whether the tower is working again — and they knew what to check before anyone here did.

completion_milestones.title: The Question Nobody Answered
completion_milestones.text: The third order was collected the same night and no fourth has appeared. Whoever was asking got the answer they came for, and has not said what they intend to do with it.
